title: Waymo expands service to Nashville International Airport
source_used: WKRN News 2 video blurb on Yahoo (Business Journals page is not readable)
key_facts: WKRN News 2 (Yahoo video page): Waymo has expanded to Nashville International Airport (BNA), becoming the first fully autonomous ride-hailing service to offer airport transportation in Tennessee.
